# JSONTestSuite

`test_parsing/` and `LICENSE` are copied unchanged from [nst/JSONTestSuite](https://github.com/nst/JSONTestSuite)
at commit 1ef36fa01286573e846ac449e8683f8833c5b26a (MIT License). Files starting with `y_` must be accepted, `n_` must
be rejected, and `i_` are left to the implementation.
